title: Slider, RadioGroup, and Switch production view integration
scope: Move selection-control layout, drawing, clipping, hit geometry, pointer state, focus, and keyboard activation into production control views.
Keep existing Slider, RadioGroup, and Switch public model structs and Gallery component identifiers.
Keep Gallery examples on the production control views and use its text engine only through ButtonTextRenderer.
behavior: Slider retains a full component frame for drawing, uses visible geometry for hit testing, clamps captured drags at either end, and cancels on hide, disable, blur, or window deactivation.

RadioGroup computes row height from shaped label metrics, supports wrapped labels, aligns its indicator to the first line, exposes one roving tab stop, and cancels stale pointer arms when focus changes or rows are fully hidden.
Whole-group RadioGroup disabled state preserves the selected model value; per-item enabled state remains on the existing model.

Switch owns the labeled row and toggle geometry, preserves the existing single-line optical offset, aligns wrapped labels by the first line, and activates on matching pointer release or Space release.
Focus rings are clipped to the ancestor viewport while component hits and label drawing remain clipped to their own visible geometry.
Gallery routes host focus changes from Tab and pointer input through a shared adapter; disabled selection-control hits do not fall through to generic Button state.

Immediate host focus handoff, roving Radio stop, disabled traversal/click guards and real-event regressions.
